verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right: logo, bag, then headline and CTA centred on one axis. Its flaws are that the green circle butts right against the end of 'Garden-fresh fizz', the CITRINE logo floats small and isolated beside the olive circle, and both circles are shrunk to whole discs instead of the original's large bleeding shapes. B stacks both circles awkwardly on the far left, leaves CITRINE stranded high instead of on a shared axis, and pushes the headline almost to the right edge with very little margin, so the right side feels cramped next to empty space on the left.
